title: Restaurant Brand Identity & Packaging Design Egypt — Cote | admepro
desc: admepro designed the Cote brand identity — a fresh, modern visual concept that communicates elegance and purpose. See the full project in our portfolio.
content: P: Cotê – the ultimate tanning experience blends the art of sun-kissed perfection with skin-loving care. Whether you choose their rich, nourishing tanning oil or the smooth, hydrating gel, Cotê delivers a natural, radiant glow. Infused with luxurious ingredients, these formulas are designed to hydrate, protect, and enhance your skin while you soak up the sun.
LI: Strategy Brand Strategy, Digital Strategy
H2: Building a Luxurious Beauty Experience Through Strategic Branding and Visual Excellence.

P: We crafted Côte from its authentic roots, blending timeless elegance with the warmth of a private, intimate retreat. From brand identity to social media strategy, we brought this exclusive, sun-kissed experience to life, transforming a vision into a luxury tanning experience.
P: By combining stunning visuals, engaging content, and targeted campaigns, we’ve ensured that it did not only shine in the marketplace but also fosters a loyal, sun-kissed community.
H2: Premium Packaging Design That Elevates the Tanning Experience.

P: Côte’s bursts with vibrant colors that evoke the warmth and energy of sun-kissed skin, its packaging features a striking combination of vibrant blue, soft pink, and rich brown, creating a perfect balance of elegance and energy.
P: The calming blue evokes the tranquil sea, while the warm pink adds a touch of femininity and playfulness. The deep brown grounds the design with a sense of luxury and sophistication.
P: Earthy browns blend seamlessly with touches of gold, celebrating nature's grounding elements.
P: Warm pink hues dance with coral undertones, reflecting the sky's golden-hour radiance.
P: Crystal-clear blues merge with gentle aqua tones, capturing the Mediterranean's serene waters.
H2: Crafting Coté's Luxe Branding Materials.

P: The signature jars feature a matte gradient finish, transitioning through sun gradient colors, embodying the brand’s coastal essence. Custom embossed detailing adds sophisticated texture while golden accents elevate the luxury experience.

P: Each canvas beauty bag showcases delicate tonal embroidery, featuring Coté’s refined logo and patterns. The sustainably sourced materials and premium hardware reflect the brand’s commitment to mindful luxury.
P: By using cote products and relevant video stocks we produced reels to reflect the vibe of summer and using the tanning oil daily on our lifestyle.
H2: Crafting Mediterranean Elegance by Producing reels.
H2: Engaging Social Media Content That Glows.
P: Côte’s social media presence mirrors its branding—inviting, inspirational, and aspirational. With carefully curated imagery, engaging content, and a consistent tone.
P: We’re a team of creatives who are excited about unique ideas and create amazing identity.
